0022600184.text: The San Antonio Spurs (5-2, winners of five straight) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, coming off a loss) in the Spurs' 8th game of the 2026-27 season, with San Antonio 3rd in the Southwest and 6th in the West, 1.5 games back in its division, while Dallas is 4th in the Southwest and 9th in the West, 2.5 games back. The Spurs lead this season's series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas on October 24, and they also won all four meetings in 2025-26. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation).
